newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Telkom loses 1 mln rand in a week to fraud.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Telkom loses 1 mln rand in a week to fraud.

text.p: South Africa's telecommunications utility Telkom said on Friday it had suffered losses amounting to at least one million rand in the past week from the fraudulent use of cardphones.
It said the rigging of the phones was most prevalent at universities, colleges and at schools in the Western Cape province.
A Telkom spokesman told Reuters the fraud involved the use of expired cards as well as increasing the value of the cards, allowing users unlimited calls, by unspecified means.
"Telkom wishes to state unequivocally that the fraudulent use of cardphones is a serious crime," Telkom said in a statement, adding that eight suspects had already been arrested.
Telecommunications Minister Jay Naidoo said on Wednesday this week the utility lost at least 775 million rand due to theft and fraud in the 1996/97 financial year.
